svg.title: Change only the certificate path and reload — instructional mockup
svg.desc: Step-specific guided recreation. Not a genuine screenshot or live result.
svg.text: INSTRUCTIONAL MOCKUP — NOT A LIVE CAPTURE OR RESULT
Change only the certificate path and reload
Application server (TLS-APP01) · RHEL 9 Bash terminal · learner@10.90.0.10
RHEL 9 — learner@tls-app01
COMMAND / FILE CONTENT TO ENTER — PRESERVE CASE
sudo sh -c 'test ! -e /root/tls-rollbacks/before-same-key.conf && cp -a /etc/nginx/conf.d/app-
tls.conf /root/tls-rollbacks/before-same-key.conf'
sudo sed -i 's@app-v1-fullchain.pem@app-r1-fullchain.pem@' /etc/nginx/conf.d/app-tls.conf
sudo grep -E 'ssl_certificate|ssl_certificate_key' /etc/nginx/conf.d/app-tls.conf
sudo nginx -t && sudo systemctl reload nginx
openssl s_client -connect 10.90.0.10:443 -servername app.example.mil -CAfile ~/tls-work/root.crt
-verify_return_error -verify_hostname app.example.mil < /dev/null
EXPECTED RESULT / SIMULATED CLUE — CHECK YOUR OWN MACHINE
The live endpoint verifies and presents the renewed serial; NGINX remains active.
FOLLOW THE NUMBERED INSTRUCTIONS IN THE LESSON
1. Paste the backup command first; it preserves the known working v1 configuration once.
2. The sed command changes only app-v1-fullchain.pem to app-r1-fullchain.pem. Read both directives
afterwards; the key must remain app-v1.key.
3. Run the guarded test and reload, then perform the live TLS test. Compare the leaf serial with the new
CA response and refresh the practice browser’s certificate view.
No real private key, real certificate result, production access or DoD endorsement is shown.
